comment: Hand-written. Implementation status of enumerated resources that differ from their kind's default. Statuses apply to both versions unless a version is named. Traces that place a block are linked to it automatically; packets referenced by the server code default to partial.

block.note: A registry state without rules of its own: represented, stored, sent, imported and exported; solid when it has a collision shape, a redstone conductor as both official servers report, moved, destroyed or left in place by pistons as the official servers do, with no drops

item.note: In the item registry with its stack size and durability: stored, moved, thrown and picked up, with no other use

biome.note: Sent in the biome registry; no world uses it

cave_air.note: Air with its own state; the rules treat it as air

void_air.note: Air with its own state; the rules treat it as air

dispenser.note: Fired 4 ticks after power reaches it or the block above it, from a random filled slot; ejects items, primes TNT, pours and fills water buckets, sets minecarts on rails, ejects equipment; read by comparators, filled and emptied by hoppers

does not equip players

dropper.note: Fired as dispensers are; puts one item into the container in front or ejects it

deviations: growth ignores light, farmland and hydration

deviations: fire, flint and steel and players do not ignite it yet
